posts.name: JJ Pearson
posts.cooked:
Just an observation upon which someone more well-spoken (well-typed?) than myself can build.

 

Spite's resurrected body's scars are eerily similar to Apostate's in shape & placement. Could the scars, or the bodies themselves, have the same origin?
